item.title: PHP Undefined Constant Notice Solved: Array Keys, Variables, and Scope Issues
item.description:
“PHP Undefined Constant Notice Solved: Array Keys, Variables, and Scope Issues”

The appearance of the “Use of undefined constant [constant_name] - assumed ‘[constant_name]’” notice in PHP often points to code where the parser interprets a token as a constant when it should have been treated as a string literal or a variable. This behavior, while historically present, can lead to subtle bugs, especially before PHP 8, where it now throws an Error.
